resources.string: What is new in Total Music %1$s

New Total Music identity.

• Google Expressive: select the new theme in Settings → Appearance.
• Total EQ: advanced 31-band mode and parametric filters.
• Preamp, bass, treble, balance, stereo width, crossfeed and peak limiter.
• Save your own sound profiles.

Original appearance, legacy EQ controls and spatial audio modes remain available.
